text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. speaker: Doctor
text:
The bilious vomiting in a newborn strongly suggests an intestinal obstruction distal to the ampulla of Vater, such as malrotation with volvulus or duodenal atresia. I need to assess the physical exam and abdominal imaging to distinguish between these possibilities.
